name: CIMemories
intro: CIMemories 是一个面向持久记忆隐私与上下文完整性的基准，使用带有丰富属性的合成用户画像和不同任务场景，评估模型是否会在不恰当情境中泄露记忆中的敏感信息。
build_method: 合成用户画像, 任务上下文组合, 记忆泄露评估
task_type: 信息流控制, 上下文完整性
eval_feature: 持久记忆, 隐私泄露, 情境完整性
intro_en: CIMemories evaluates whether persistent-memory systems in LLMs preserve contextual integrity. It measures if models reveal memory attributes only when the task context makes them appropriate.
build_method_en: Synthetic user profiles, compositional task contexts, memory-leakage evaluation
eval_feature_en: Persistent Memory, Privacy Leakage, Contextual Integrity
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["先为每个用户合成包含 100+ 属性的长期记忆画像"] --> B["围绕同一属性构造允许使用与禁止使用的任务上下文"]
    B --> C["把记忆条目、任务提示和对抗提示组合成评测样本"]
    C --> D["让带持久记忆的模型在不同上下文中完成任务"]
    D --> E["检查回答是否在不恰当场景泄露记忆属性"]
    E --> F["统计 attribute-level violation rate 与任务效用"]
    F --> G["进一步分析多任务累积与多次采样带来的泄露增长"]
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Synthesize persistent user profiles with 100+ attributes each"] --> B["Create task contexts where each attribute is either appropriate or inappropriate to reveal"]
    B --> C["Compose benchmark samples from memory items, task prompts, and adversarial prompts"]
    C --> D["Run memory-enabled models across these contextualized tasks"]
    D --> E["Check whether answers leak attributes in the wrong context"]
    E --> F["Measure attribute-level violation rate and task utility"]
    F --> G["Analyze leakage growth across more tasks and repeated generations"]
